_comment: Where the holders of the non-ICB agreements that permit sublicensing record what happens to the data next. One entry per holder, naming its agreements by base reference. `kind` is `sub-licensees` for a list of organisations the data was passed on to, and `approved uses` for a register of projects approved to use it, usually inside the holder's own trusted research environment. `source` is the holder's page that links a register kept elsewhere. `opened: false` marks a page found by search that refuses requests from the build environment, so it was not opened. Notes are shown to readers. Collected by hand; check with `python -m pipeline.onward`.

aggregators.title: Health Data Research Gateway data use register
aggregators.note: 2,580 data uses from 27 custodians on the date checked, 150 of them from the NHS England Secure Data Environment. The Gateway's terms allow downloading extracts for the reader's own use, so republishing its entries needs HDR UK's agreement.

registers.note: Ongoing and completed projects are listed on pages beside it.
